notes.title: WEEKLONG discount opportunity
notes.content:
Thinking of taking a tropical island trip?

We can't promise it will be a chill experience, because the waters of Mara are full of adventures, but you will also be able to relax in some moments taking care of your island, farming and building to make it your real home.

We are talking about Summer in Mara! 

Take advantage of the Weeklong Deal to join this adventure at a special price (60% off), but only from January 15th to January 21st.

[previewyoutube=Iqhy0lmhjQU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











About Summer in Mara

‘Summer in Mara’ is a single-player experience in a calm, relaxing environment, with a handmade look and an exciting narrative. You will be Koa, a little adventurer girl who wants to explore the world that surrounds her.

KEY FEATURES

- An open ocean with over 20 islands to explore.

- Customize your own island with buildings, crops, and farm animals.

- Over 25 characters to meet and befriend.

- More than 300 quests to make Mara a better place.

- Day and night cycle that has an effect on the world with climatic events.

Already have Summer in Mara in your library? Even better! Take advantage of the Mara Collection bundle to get Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara almost for free and continue your adventures with Koa and Napopo.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33954/Mara_Collection/

Warm up your cold winter days with these stories full of tropical vibes.

May the winds of Mara be kind to you!

notes.title: Summer in Mara Physical Collector's Edition on its way!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We’re back another day with exciting news. We started Chibig with an idea in our minds: to create a colorful and relaxing universe that the player would fall in love with. After Deiland: Pocket Planet, Summer in Mara, and now Ankora: Lost Days, we’re getting there, step by step.

Now, we’re happy to announce that our universe is getting bigger thanks to Tesura Games, a Spanish physical publisher that will help us to carry our worlds to your hands. We had signed a partnership with them to take our games to the physical world and now it’s time for Summer in Mara.

Thanks to Tesura, Summer in Mara will be released in physical, both in standard and Collector’s Edition, for Nintendo Switch and Playstation 4 (but you can play it on your Playstation 5).

And this is everything it includes:

 Game
 Collector's Box
 Artbook
 Napopo pin
 Diorama
 Double-Sided Poster
 Stickers


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/61c802b64b901845884dc15df3b7807015bcfb9d.png

Although it isn't a final date confirmed for this physical edition yet, we are pretty confident it will be available before the end of this year. So stay tuned and see you in Mara!

notes.title: Stories of Mara, a visual novel slice-of-life will be out on August 26th!
notes.content:
Hi there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/2c6763d5a05102a8f68c824187f9addf6709f68c.jpg

We're thrill to announce that Stories of Mara, an episodic visual novel that tells the story of the neighbors of Mara, will be out on August 26th! Chapter One will be free on Steam and Itch.io. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1647780/Stories_of_Mara/

Set in the same universe as Deiland Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara, Stories of Mara describe the little tidbits of life happening in these islands where your choices will define the course of the story and affect the relationships with the community.

[previewyoutube=8gjeRRMm1lM;full][/previewyoutube]

Chapter One starts following Akaji, a procrastinating blacksmith who has to ask for the help of all her neighbors to find Koa, who has disappeared while dealing with her own issues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/9b23aefd1383eec7c4d115a8bd36b553f5ecb0f2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/734b1125f9fdc948aa418057e2be3de0eb51f1ed.png

Key Features

  
   A bit-sized slice of life visual novel following a diverse cast from the calm and relaxing supernatural world of Summer in Mara. A soap opera featuring from trickster pirates to adventurer cat-children.    

     Depending on how you bond with the cast will affect the relationships with the community and the ending. Your choices matter in the course of the story throughout different chapters.
 
      Express yourself through making boat modelism to share with the rest of the community. This will impact how they see you and how you see them.

Visuals inspired by the Studio Ghibli films with a modern setting in a fantasy universe.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/98224c81623396cece46459d49922eff5a4a28c4.gif

See you in Mara!

And don’t miss the OST:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1400590/Summer_in_Mara__OST/

From the relaxing and calm beaches of Mara to the exciting pirate adventures and the moving feelings of a lost and found orphan child.

notes.title: UPDATE: Fast travel and additional crafting points
notes.content:
Dear players,

A week ago we released Summer in Mara. During this week, you give us your feedback regarding different issues and ideas for us to work on and improve. 

We heard you and we want to use your feedback to improve Summer in Mara. In this update we implemented two features that will improve the experience of the game:


  Fast travel: Now Koa can travel immediately to any island that you have discovered previously. This way, you don't have to go from quadrant to quadrant, avoiding loading screens.

  Crafting and cooking. We thought it's a good idea to let Koa craft and cook in other islands, near to the main characters. Now you can craft/cook in Taka's restaurant, Akaji forge and Dunna's island.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/d2db6b5959f554769fb0f0db27e6d6a7095f8500.png

We hope these improvements help you during the game. Please, keep sharing your feedback and feel free to give us your opinion.

See you in Mara,
Chibig.

notes.title: Updates Roadmap
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thanks for support Summer in Mara, thanks for play it and thanks for your feedback.

We are 5 people in Chibig just now. We are putting all our efforts to improve the game, fix the issues and heard all your comments. However we can't go as fast as we would like, so we appeal to your patience.

We are really commited with Summer in Mara, we think it is a good game that can be better. Those are our priorities by now:

GENERAL
- Fix the bugs!
- Improve some feedback to guide the player: like add more arrows and tip text in some quests.
- Improve Koa's controls.
- Balance the time pass and questlines.

GAMEPLAY
- Add fast - travel to any island you have visited.
- Add craft tables in other points outside Koa - island (like restaurants or workshops).
- Improve the sailing experience.

UI
- Add "delete save" option ingame.
- Add some extra option to configurate the camera (fov, sensitivity)
- Add window mode options.
- Add Koa position to Qälis map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33825795/89f6ec3f85f81c8a1a63ee1b429959f3c151c432.png

We are working on this during the next weeks. Please feel free to suggest any other changes that you think good improvements for "Summer in Mara".

See you in Mara!

notes.title: Qälis - The main island in Mara
notes.content:
We want to show you a little bit more about the main island in the game. Qälis is a small town with different qüidos, humans, cat-children and maybe even an elit or two. In this city, you can see the mixture of cultures scattered all through Mara. Old exotic qüido structures and symbols combine with more new and modern buildings. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/ab2c8474fd99fffa70173bbb612a58ccf4b5ddb1.png

A view of Qälis from your boat. This is the main island in the game, where you will meet people, trade with them and discover lots of secrets from Mara.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/cf773e2bf273e44cf3432d76b60e992f18df3647.png

The market in the island. Three twins run this place, but be careful with them, since they can be really tricky.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/64aa0d53d6c691bf2d4735aa417c27610582ca1b.png

In Qälis Temple you can meet Blu, a strange individual that doesn't talk much. But when Blu talks... Nobody knows what he meants. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/89f6ec3f85f81c8a1a63ee1b429959f3c151c432.png

Taka's Restaurant is famous in all Mara. He's a great chef, but very traditionalist. Brram, his nephew, wants to be like his uncle... But also wants to explore the galaxy. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/5759e5dc0456cb593a7ce9548709301b4b1e15d1.png

Akaji is the blacksmith in Qälis. In her forge, you can see her latest work. Like, well, can you see what emerge from the ground? 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/258701ee0c97ac5b27118566a7dda8e51c25c770.png

Onzo is a cat-child, but also the adventurer like you! He kepts all kind of stories in his diary!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/b493f946c3775cc84a6ad94dcdc600db5d26c930.png

Awan's Tabern is a great place to enjoy a different meal. But a lot of qüidos don't like this kind of cuisine. 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825795/1e4620b09aba7f9bff4fb704665ef2b0579ea661.png

Another view of Qälis.

Remember you can support us through Indiegogo and you will get a pre-launch copy of the game and other great goodies! 

https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/summer-in-mara-adventure-set-in-a-tropical-ocean#/
